Melee: Swords, spears and yoyos. High defence, short reach.
Ranged: Bows, guns and launchers. Needs ammo, hits hardest at distance.
Summoner: Minions and whips fight for you. Frail alone.
Thrower: Thorium's throwing class — consumables and returning weapons.
Bard: Thorium's support class. Buffs scale with party size — strong in co-op.
Healer: Thorium's healer. Only functions in multiplayer.
